# Sprint Review Report

**Generated by Horseless Carriage v0.1.0** (Interaction Level: Product)

## Summary
Sprint 4 successfully delivered and accepted all planned sprint backlog items: US-0007 (Distributed Ray Cluster Bootstrap on Client Nodes) and US-0008 (Ollama Model Runner and Local Inference Execution). This establishes distributed Ray worker clustering and local Ollama model execution on client daemons. All code was reviewed by Architect, verified by QA, and merged into develop.

## Accomplishments
- Implemented and accepted US-0007 (Distributed Ray Cluster Bootstrap on Client Nodes), enabling client daemons to launch containerized Ray workers, connect to cluster heads, and cleanly leave upon node busy state or disconnection.
- Implemented and accepted US-0008 (Ollama Model Runner and Local Inference Execution), providing automated container management, model pulling, inference proxying, and token throughput calculation.
- Completed 100% of planned Sprint 4 user stories (US-0007 and US-0008) within token and cost budgets.
- Architectural review and QA verification completed with all tests passing and PRs #17 and #18 merged into develop.
